visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a 2D animation of a man with short dark hair lying on his back in a bed with gray sheets and a white pillow. He has his mouth wide open, and his eyes are closed in sleep. A black text box at the top contains white text 「打呼的類型」 while a white box below it says 「卡痰式」. The man's throat and chest vibrate slightly to indicate snoring. (2) The scene cuts to the man in the same position, but the text box now reads 「震唇式」. His lips are drawn back, exposing his teeth, and they are shown fluttering and vibrating rapidly as if air is being forced through them. The lighting is dim and monochromatic, typical of a night scene in a bedroom. (3) The man continues to lie in bed, but now the text says 「斷氣式」. His face begins to turn a deep red color, and small beads of sweat appear on his forehead. His mouth is initially closed, then he opens it wide with a strained expression as he seemingly struggles to breathe after a period of stillness. (4) The animation changes to show the man with a pink pig's snout and large floppy pig ears overlaid on his face. The text box at the top now reads 「豬叫式」. He is shown with his mouth open, and his throat is vibrating again. The background remains consistent with a simple bedroom setting and a headboard visible. (5) In this phase, the man is seen holding a large black and yellow electric drill against his open mouth. The text box indicates 「電鑽式」. He has a strained, toothy grin as the drill is positioned near his teeth. Spark-like lines appear near the drill bit to suggest high-speed rotation and friction. (6) The camera pans or zooms out slightly to reveal a woman lying next to the man in the same bed. She is staring blankly at the viewer with extremely large, bloodshot eyes and heavy dark circles underneath them, conveying immense exhaustion and annoyance. Shaky zigzag lines are drawn around her head to indicate frustration as the man continues his mechanical snoring.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a series of rhythmic, low-frequency snores characterized by a heavy, rattling texture. These sounds exhibit a distinct "phlegm-stuck" quality with a raspy, moist timbre and a broadband spectral profile. There is no background music, creating a focused acoustic environment on the snoring events which occur at a steady, slow tempo. (2) A transition in sound occurs where the low-frequency rattling is replaced by a rapid, percussive flapping sound created by the vibration of lips. This sound has a higher transient density and a more fluttering acoustic shape. The environmental noise floor is extremely low, typical of a studio-produced animation track, with no other ambient layers or music present. (3) The audio track goes into a period of strategic silence for several seconds, representing a breath-holding phase. This is followed by a sudden, high-arousal explosive snort and a deep, strained intake of air. The dynamic range is significant here, moving from near-silence to a sharp peak in amplitude during the gasping event. (4) The sound profile shifts again to a series of high-pitched, nasal grunts that closely mimic the vocalizations of a pig. These sounds have a sharp attack and a short decay, repeating in a rhythmic fashion. The acoustic brightness increases in this phase due to the nasal resonances of the synthesized snorting sound effects. (5) A loud, mechanical whirring sound of an electric drill dominates the mix. It has a high-pitched, metallic screeching texture with significant harmonic richness and constant intensity. This sound masks any other potential audio signals. In the final seconds, a faint, high-frequency sine-wave-like ringing sound is layered on top, symbolizing the psychological stress of the listener.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comedic animation designed to hyperbolically portray various annoying snoring styles and the resulting sleep deprivation of a partner. It uses visual metaphors like a pig snout and an electric drill to emphasize the auditory discomfort.
